messages.body_plain:
Hey #R Folks!

Check out the upcoming CA Water Data Challenge. Consider registering (it's free) and a good opportunity to play/wrangle with data and visualization!

Adios,
Ryan

---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Rich Pauloo <rpa...@ucdavis.edu>
Date: Thu, Aug 13, 2020 at 10:59 AM
Subject: [dsiaffiliates] [NEXT WEEK] Register for the 2020 California Water Data Challenge
To: <dsiaff...@ucdavis.edu>

Contrary to what you may think, you don't need a hydrology background to participate, but data chops are a must.

The datathon is a great way to meet people, apply data science skills to existing problems, and potentially win one of 10 $1500 cash prizes.

The first datathon is next week Aug 18-19, and registration <https://www.eventbrite.com/e/datathon-the-5th-annual-ca-water-data-summit-and-water-solutions-5-registration-111690603602> can be found at this link.

Best,
Rich

--
Rich Pauloo
